title: Homogeneous quadratic PCPP description
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, each specified by a coefficient matrix and a right-hand side. There is a Boolean proof-checking description for the set of Boolean assignments whose corresponding vectors over the field with two elements satisfy every equation in $L$: it has proof length $2^n+2^{n^2}$, query count four, and rejection-rate parameter $1/100000$, and its system satisfies the perfect-completeness and far-from-satisfying rejection conditions at that rate.
hypotheses_covered: A list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
caveat: The formal definition supplies the PCPP property through a referenced theorem whose proof is not included, and the satisfaction and distance notions are only available via the provided upstream definitions.
